newsitem.title: USA: USG spot jet prices rally, refiner buying cited.
newsitem.headline: USG spot jet prices rally, refiner buying cited.

text.p: U.S. Gulf spot jet fuel prices surged higher as differentials there jumped on renewed refinery buying Tuesday, traders said.
"We saw a lot of quality buying at the Gulf," one market player said, which allowed sellers to boost their offers.
USG spot 54-grade jet fuel for back 8th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline was talked between 2.25 and 2.50 cents over the screen, up about 1.00 cent on the day.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade was talked between about 4.25 and 4.50 cents above the screen late in the day, up more than 0.25 cent from Monday.
Refinery buying had been behind surges in Houston differential levels last week, one market trader said.
The gain in diffs outpaced the 0.25 cent drop in NYMEX April heating oil futures, the spot market basis.
